Upload a file and save a record to the files collection.

get.summary: Download a file by its record ID

Download a file by its record ID.
Looks up the files collection by id, reads the binary from disk, and
returns it base64-encoded so the route layer can stream it to the client.

emailLists.description: Legacy segment id array — prefer audienceSegments. type:array (not json) so the module-framework sanitizer persists the string[] instead of dropping it. Mirrors emailDripCampaigns.emailLists so a new email drip copies the campaign-level selection on create.

audienceSegments.description: Campaign-level segment ids — the SELECTED (checked) subset of stagedSegments. string[]. type:array (not json) so the module-framework sanitizer persists the string[]. Copied into new email/social drips on create (drips diverge freely afterwards; never re-synced).

stagedSegments.description: Campaign-level segment ids staged in the segment-list UI (the list shown to the user). audienceSegments is the selected/enrolled subset of these. string[]. type:array (not json) so the module-framework sanitizer persists the string[].
